arguments.sql: SELECT h.*, (SELECT sum("DR_AMT")-sum("CR_AMT") FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO") diff FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE "REF_JRNL_NO" IS NOT NULL OR "JRNL_NO" IN (SELECT "JRNL_NO" FROM "GLJRNL" GROUP BY 1 HAVING sum("DR_AMT")<>sum("CR_AMT")) OR "JRNL_NO" IN (SELECT h2."JRNL_NO" FROM "GLJRNH" h2 JOIN "GLPERD" p ON p."PRD_ID"=h2."PRD_ID" WHERE h2."POST_DT" NOT BETWEEN p."STRT_DT" AND p."END_DT")
SELECT h."SRC_CD", l."ACCT_CD", count(*) n, count(distinct h."JRNL_NO") j, sum(l."DR_AMT") dr, sum(l."CR_AMT") cr FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLJRNL" l USING("JRNL_NO") GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT h."JRNL_NO", h."SRC_CD", h."SRC_REF", h."MEMO", h."POST_DT", l."LN_SEQ", l."ACCT_CD", l."DR_AMT", l."CR_AMT", i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", i."INV_DT", i."STAT_CD" FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLJRNL" l USING("JRNL_NO") LEFT JOIN "APINVH" i ON i."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO" WHERE h."JRNL_NO" IN (SELECT "JRNL_NO" FROM "GLJRNH" ORDER BY "JRNL_NO" LIMIT 3) OR h."JRNL_NO" IN (SELECT "JRNL_NO" FROM "GLJRNH" WHERE "SRC_CD"='GL' ORDER BY "JRNL_NO" LIMIT 3) ORDER BY 1,6
